title: Output on the empty input
statement: Let the transducer have states $\{n,g,k_1,k_2(0),k_2(1),a,u,o\}$, transition function given by the stated rules, and emit the input bit only when the current state is $o$, emitting nothing otherwise. For every starting state $q$, its output on the empty bit string is the empty string.
hypotheses_covered: The starting state q is one of the transducer states.
